messages:
maria-partnerships: Hey team — uploading the co-branded case visuals for CloudScale. Figma: https://figma.com/file/CloudScaleCase and PDF mockups: https://drive.redwood/cloudscale-case.pdf Please do a quick pass for logo usage + headline lockups. Need final by EOD Friday.
ajay-marketing: Thanks — is CloudScale insistent on the full-color logo only? Partner sent a PNG + SVG set but their brand guide mentions a mono lockup for dark backgrounds.
sam-design: I built two comps (horizontal + stacked). PNGs exported @2x in assets/exports. Quick notes: avoid resizing CloudScale mark >120px in stacked layout, keep 3mm clear space. I'll paste the Figma frame IDs in the doc.
maria-partnerships: Correct — partner brand guidelines say full-color preferred but mono ok for low-contrast materials. I'll attach the official excerpt.
olivia-legal: Can we confirm we have written permission for use in press and case studies? Need partner-signed logo usage addendum before public release. Also check trademark notice placement.
derek-sales: Also want a 1-paragraph customer quote slot and CloudScale logo next to our Redwood badge on the one-pager. Prefer their logo left of ours.
sam-design: Noted. I can deliver a version with quote and one without. Which font should we use for the headline? CloudScale uses Inter var, do we stick to Redwood system font?
ajay-marketing: Use Redwood's deck font (Inter) to keep deck consistent; for co-branded website hero we'll match CloudScale's heading weight for the mock.
maria-partnerships: Uploading the logo guideline excerpt here: https://drive.redwood/CloudScale_logo_guidelines.pdf
olivia-legal: Quick flag — the guidelines say "do not alter colors" and "do not place on patterned backgrounds". We'll need to ensure our hero comps respect that.
design-bot: export complete: assets/exports/cloudscale_case_horizontal@2x.png (345KB), assets/exports/cloudscale_case_stacked@2x.png (298KB)
sam-design: Uploaded updated comps with spacing fixes. Comments left in Figma: @ajay-marketing @maria-partnerships
ajay-marketing: Looking now :eyes: small nit — in the stacked layout the CloudScale mark feels a bit close to the CTA. Can we nudge left 8px?
sam-design: Yep will do and re-export in 10m.
maria-partnerships: Reminder — PR sync on Thursday 11:00 PT. We need final visual + legal ok before then.
olivia-legal: I'll follow up with CloudScale legal for the signed addendum. If I don't hear back by Wed EOD we'll need to delay PR.
derek-sales: If legal's delayed, can we still publish a non-public case brief for sales enablement? Internal-only asset ok?
maria-partnerships: Yes — internal-only brief is fine until legal clears public usage. Tag me when ready.
ajay-marketing: Approved from marketing side pending legal. :thumbsup: 
sam-design: Resubmitted assets with 8px nudge and adjusted contrast for accessibility. New files: assets/exports/cloudscale_case_horizontal_v2@2x.png
maria-partnerships: Great work everyone. Closing thread once legal confirms. Thanks :raised_hands:
